objects.description: [FIN13](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1016) has masqueraded WAR files to look like legitimate packages such as, wsexample.war, wsexamples.com, examples.war, and exampl3s.war.(Citation: Sygnia Elephant Beetle Jan 2022)
